system_prompt_additions: Seed small deterministic data and read it back with find or aggregation to confirm setup before exercising the target feature. Every probe must include one empty, unmatched, or no-op case (no-match join, empty facet branch, single-doc window partition with null shift, arrayFilter matching zero, abort or invisible-transaction path, empty poll, collation non-match, partial-filter non-match, validator rejection) and assert the empty, null, or unchanged result explicitly. Exercise one boundary or rarely-used option (maxDepth/depthField, range-window edge, second arrayFilter identifier, partial filter with comparison, update-validation path) and compare exact read-back values and counts.

per_feature_hints.F1: Empty join and empty facet branch: seed one customer with zero matching orders plus one customer with two in-range orders; run $lookup with let/pipeline that matches zero docs for the first customer and $facet where one sub-pipeline matches zero docs; read back that the no-match lookup preserves the outer doc with empty array [], facet empty branch returns [], and counts/totals are 0 (double totals converted to cents via $cond on $type plus $round).
per_feature_hints.F3: No-match no-op plus two identifiers: seed order with 2 lines (line_id A/B, refund_status none); run filtered positional update with arrayFilters matching zero elements (line_id Z) and read back doc unchanged with matchedCount 0 modifiedCount 0; then run update with two arrayFilters identifiers on the same element (e.g., set refunded and reviewed) and read back that only line A changed both fields.
per_feature_hints.X: maxDepth limit plus unmatched start: seed linear chain A<-B<-C<-D via referred_by to _id; run $graphLookup from D with depthField depth and maxDepth 1 and read back exactly 2 ancestors with depths 0 and 1; rerun with maxDepth 0 (1 ancestor) and with startWith non-existent _id and read back outer doc preserved with empty referrers array [].

required_checks: Read back seeded documents before the target operation to confirm setup.
Include and assert one empty, unmatched, or no-op case with empty array, null, or zero modifications.
Convert double totals to cents with $cond on $type plus $round before comparing.
